feed.description: Gives the job a feed: a list of items shown in the Feed overlay and a sidebar section. The command runs after every successful run, on demand and at server start, and must print one feed v1 JSON object (see flockr-feed.schema.json).

command.description: Required argv array whose stdout is the feed JSON and nothing else.

title.description: Section title; wins over the feed's own title.

feedWork.description: What `w` does in the Feed overlay: start an agent in a new tab on the selected items (or the current item when none is selected). Every key is optional; without the table, `claude` starts in the job's cwd (else your home directory) with a built-in prompt. Template variables in tab_title, cwd, agent_command, prompt and the prompt file: {{items}} {{items_json}} {{count}} {{date}} {{job.id}} {{job.title}} {{feed.title}} {{item.id}} {{item.title}} {{item.subtitle}} {{item.badge}} {{item.url}} {{item.state}} {{item.group}} {{item.updated_at}} {{item.body}} and {{item.field.<label>}} (a field of the first item, label in lower case with other characters as _). {{item.*}} is the first selected item. Substitution is a single pass, so item text cannot inject further placeholders; an unknown or missing variable renders empty with a warning.

agent_command.description: The agent CLI, run in a new tab. Add {prompt_file} to pass the rendered prompt file anywhere; otherwise the prompt becomes the first argument.

cwd.description: Directory of the new tab; ~ and templates work. Default: the job's cwd when it sets one, else your home directory. A directory that does not exist falls back to the default.

prompt.description: Inline prompt template; use this or prompt_file, not both. Default: a built-in prompt that lists the items and asks for a summary and a plan before any change.

prompt_file.description: Prompt template, relative to the job directory. The rendered prompt is capped at 200000 characters; {{items}} at 60000 (each body at 2000), {{items_json}} at 48000, at most 50 items are used.

tab_title.description: Title of the new tab (templated; cut to this length). Default: "{{job.title}} · {{count}} items".

handoff.description: After a run the job may ask whether to start an agent tab; nothing starts until the user answers. Template variables in ask, tab_title, cwd, agent_command, prompt and the prompt file: {{stdout}} {{stderr_tail}} {{exit_code}} {{feed_json}} {{count}} {{date}} {{job.id}} {{job.title}} {{run.id}} and {{context.<path>}} (from a dynamic flockr_handoff line's context object). Substitution is a single pass, so job output cannot inject further placeholders; an unknown or missing variable renders empty with a warning.

agent_command.description: The agent CLI, run in a new tab. Add {prompt_file} to pass the rendered prompt file anywhere; otherwise the prompt becomes the first argument.

ask.description: The question shown in the toast and the Decisions tab (templated; one line, cut to this length).

cwd.description: Directory of the new tab; ~ and templates work. Default: the job directory.

prompt.description: Inline prompt template; use this or prompt_file, not both.

prompt_file.description: Prompt template, relative to the job directory. The rendered prompt is capped at 200000 characters; {{stdout}} at 12000, {{stderr_tail}} at 4000, {{feed_json}} at 48000, each context value at 8000.

tab_title.description: Title of the new tab (templated; cut to this length).

when.description: When a finished run asks. on_change compares stdout and the feed with the previous run. exit:<code> matches one exit code.

jobsConfig.description: The [jobs] section of config.toml. User jobs live in job.toml files; this section only tunes the jobs flockr ships with, keyed by name without the `system.` prefix.

every.description: Interval such as "24h" (minimum 1m). Set this or schedule, not both.

schedule.description: Five-field cron expression in local time. Set this or every, not both.

description: A scheduled job: ~/.config/flockr/jobs/<id>/job.toml. Unknown keys are errors. The [jobs.system.*] section described under $defs.jobsConfig is not part of job.toml; it belongs in config.toml.

command.description: Required argv array; the first element is the program. Flockr does not run a shell unless you do (["sh", "-c", "..."]).

cwd.description: Working directory. Default: the job directory.

enabled.description: `flockr job new` writes false. `flockr job enable` overrides this value.

env.description: Where the environment comes from. A string sets the mode. A table holds non-secret KEY = "value" overrides applied after env_file, with the reserved key `mode` setting the mode (TOML cannot hold both an env string and an [env] table). Values are always strings.

env_file.description: KEY=VALUE lines added to the environment; relative to the job directory.

every.description: Interval such as 30m, 1h or 1h30m (units s, m, h, d; minimum 1m). Exactly one of schedule and every.

id.description: Optional. Must equal the job directory's name when present.

notify.description: When a finished run shows a toast.

schedule.description: Five-field cron expression in local time (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week). Exactly one of schedule and every.

timeout.description: Longest a run may take (minimum 1s, maximum 1d). On expiry the command and its process group are stopped.

title.description: Name shown in lists and toasts. Default: the id.

title: flockr job.toml
